Project.NAME: frontend-livecoding-tasks
Project.keywords: frontend, live-coding, knowledge-base, markdown, javascript, typescript, react
Project.annotation: Knowledge base of frontend live-coding tasks maintained primarily as Markdown documents with JavaScript, TypeScript, and React examples; tasks are not expected to run from the repository by default.

M-GOVERNANCE.NAME: ProjectGovernance
M-GOVERNANCE.purpose: Define authoring, delivery, student-card, collection synchronization, editor evidence, verification, and stop-condition rules for the repository.

export-authoringRules.PURPOSE: Expose two-mode task authoring, worktree isolation, delivery, editor-profile, preservation, and collection synchronization requirements

export-verificationContracts.PURPOSE: Expose shared completion evidence and phase gates

M-TASK-TEMPLATE.NAME: TaskTemplate
M-TASK-TEMPLATE.purpose: Define ordinary code-first and complex GitHub-rendered structures for copy-ready self-contained frontend task cards.

type-TaskMetadata.PURPOSE: Exact five fields and controlled values for technology, thematic collection, format, difficulty, and integer duration

type-StudentTaskCard.PURPOSE: Title, navigation, editor instruction, visible condition, complete starter code, readiness criteria, three hints, solution, self-check, optional reading, five-field metadata, and return instruction

type-EditorProfile.PURPOSE: Programiz, CodePen, TypeScript Playground, or React TypeScript copy-run contract

export-taskSchema.PURPOSE: Expose both exact card orders, copy-ready and FILE rules, progressive disclosure, navigation, and self-check structure

M-TASK-VALIDATION.NAME: TaskValidation
M-TASK-VALIDATION.purpose: Deduplicate candidates and validate new or migrated cards for structure, source-contract preservation, content, target-editor behavior, collection synchronization, and rendering.
M-TASK-VALIDATION.path: docs/task-validation-policy.md; Beads validation and technical wave-publication records

type-CandidateRegister.PURPOSE: Finite Beads inventory with stable candidate IDs and one validation decision per entry

type-CardMigrationEvidence.PURPOSE: Slug, mode, editor profile, source learning goal, prerequisite, runtime assumption, destination locations, expected, actual, and verdict

export-validateCandidate.PURPOSE: Apply preservation, structure, content, target-editor, synchronization, and rendered gates in addition to candidate validation

M-TASK-LIBRARY.NAME: TaskLibrary
M-TASK-LIBRARY.purpose: Store accepted, locally complete StudentTaskCards with copy-ready code, fixed editor profiles, exact navigation, and five-field metadata.

type-TaskMetadataSet.PURPOSE: Collection of five-field task metadata records exposed to thematic and interview collections

export-taskCard.PURPOSE: Expose one complete copy-ready StudentTaskCard through GitHub

const-cardMigrationState.PURPOSE: Phase 8 contract implemented; all twenty existing card migrations remain pending in Phases 10 through 13
